automationNotes: Covers the Unlock Users section of https://www.contentstack.com/docs/developers/security/account-lockout-policy. The lockout policy table and best practices sections are informational with no UI steps. Navigates to Administration > Users via App Switcher, then unlocks a user via the Action column ellipsis menu. Only the individual-unlock path (ellipsis) is automated; bulk-unlock via checkboxes is an alternate path in the same doc step. Requires at least one eligible locked user in the test org — if none exist, the Unlock User option will not appear. Any step that fails means the app does not match the documentation; the documentation must be updated.
